title: Can Attribution Predict Risk? From Multi-View Attribution to Planning Risk Signals in End-to-End Autonomous Driving
abstract: arXiv:2605.06264v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving models generate future trajectories from multi-view inputs, improving system integration but introducing opaque decisions and hard-to-localize risks. Existing methods either rely on auxiliary monitoring models or generate textual explanations, but are decoupled from the planning process and fail to reveal the visual evidence underlying trajectory generation. While attribution offers a direct alternative, planning differs from image classification by taking six-view camera images as input and predicting continuous multi-step trajectories, requiring attribution to capture both critical views and regions and their influence on outputs. Moreover, whether attribution maps can support risk identification remains underexplored. To address this, we propose a hierarchical attribution framework for end-to-end planning. translated_title: 归因能否预测风险？从多视角归因到端到端自动驾驶中的规划风险信号
translated_abstract: 端到端自动驾驶模型从多视角输入生成未来轨迹，提升了系统集成度，但引入了不透明的决策和难以定位的风险。现有方法要么依赖辅助监控模型，要么生成文本解释，但这些都与规划过程脱节，无法揭示轨迹生成背后的视觉证据。尽管归因提供了一种直接替代方案，但规划不同于图像分类，它接收六视角摄像头图像并预测连续的多步轨迹，要求归因同时捕捉关键视角和区域及其对输出的影响。此外，归因图能否支持风险识别仍未得到充分探索。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种用于端到端规划的层次化归因框架。具体而言，以与原始轨迹的L2一致性为目标，我们设计了一种协同方法，该方法能够从多视角输入中提取关键视觉证据，并生成与规划过程紧密关联的风险信号，从而提升风险定位和可解释性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种层次化归因框架，通过多视角输入与轨迹一致性目标，首次将归因图直接用于端到端自动驾驶规划中的风险识别与定位。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a hierarchical attribution framework that, for the first time, directly links attribution maps to risk identification in end-to-end autonomous driving planning via multi-view inputs and trajectory consistency objectives.
